nodes.name: manifest-v1.1.schema.json
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON Schema for evaluation-corpus manifests, including document sources, annotation paths, feature labels, synthetic status, and expected document types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 with closed object shapes and explicit nullable fields.

nodes.name: regression-policy-v1.schema.json
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON Schema for benchmark regression rules with metric paths, preferred direction, and minimum, maximum, or maximum-regression thresholds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 to enforce one or more bounded threshold forms per rule.
